== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A [[Territory]] is a specialized realm or domain that can be accessed through traveling. These locations are characterized by distinct districts, such as the [[Silver]], [[Rose]], Blue, and White districts. Some Territories contain massive natural features, including forests with trees so large their lowest branches reach heights comparable to mountains. Within these realms, an individual may serve as an [[Incarnation]], a role that allows them to bond with the essence of the [[Territory]] and enhances their mental clarity. An [[Incarnation]]'s power is significantly bolstered while they are within their own domain, granting them advantages over intruders. [[Alin]], an [[Incarnation of Elysia]], possesses a [[Territory]] that includes a city he has personally overseen the construction of. These realms can be accessed via doors or barriers, and they serve as vital locations for the movement of various forces and [[Travelers]].}}
